title: 第23章 诡一出场第24章 晦气
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
但沈算心中酝酿的计划——“诡市”
光有勇猛无比的战士是不够的，他需要能理解指令、识别标记、甚至进行简单的交流，以及外出执行任务能力诡卫。
因此，才有了这心眸虚界中的奇异课堂。
沈算决定，就从最基础的识文断字开始，尝试做一个合格的启蒙老师，为诡卫注入一丝“智慧”
的火种。
半月时光匆匆而过。
“哒哒”
的马蹄声打破了乡道的宁静。
沈算带着钟源，策马轻快地小跑在通往西山乱坟岗的土路上。
夏季的风带着草木的气息拂面而来。
“少爷，”
钟源策马紧跟在侧，脸上带着明显的忧虑，又一次忍不住开口确认，“咱们真的……只是去溜达一圈？太阳落山前肯定能回来？不过夜？”
出发前，钟叔可是对他千叮咛万嘱咐：若少爷黄昏时还滞留乱坟岗附近，必须力劝其返程，必要时甚至可以强行带离！
总之，绝不能让少爷再在那鬼地方过夜！
“源哥，”
沈算无奈地叹了口气，这已经是路上第十几次被问了。
“你就把心放回肚子里吧！
少爷我真的是去办点小事，办完就走，绝不耽搁！
待会儿到了地方，你自然就明白了。”
他语气笃定。

“少爷，您别嫌属下啰嗦，”
钟源挠了挠头，憨厚的脸上满是担忧，“实在是那地方……太邪性了！
上次过夜的经历，属下现在想起来还后怕呢！”
“知道知道，”
沈算摆摆手，“我放着府里好吃好喝、安稳舒适的日子不过，跑去那鬼地方自寻死路？你少爷我有那么傻吗？”
“呃……那倒也是！”
钟源想了想，觉得少爷说得在理，终于稍稍安心了些。
他忽然想起另一件事，忙道：“对了少爷，差点忘了正事。
钟叔说百修楼已经步入正轨，是时候招些伙计了。
让我和钟进、钟广，回归护卫本职。”
“招伙计？好事啊！”
沈算点头赞同，“确实该招了。
对了，我让你暗中物色的人选，有眉目了吗？”
他指的是为未来“诡市”
物色可靠外围人员的事。
“人选属下倒是初步筛选了几个，”
钟源压低了些声音，“都是些机灵、口风紧、有点门路的小子。
但钟叔说事关重大，得再观察观察，考核一番，确定真正可靠、值得一用，才能最终定下来。”
“嗯，”
沈算神色认真起来，“发展下线，关乎核心机密，确实需要慎之又慎。

你们把好关，慢慢来，不急。
八月前给我一份最终确定的人选名单就行。”
“是！
属下明白！”
content_en:
But the plan brewing in Shen Suan's mind - "Scam City"
It is not enough to have an extremely brave warrior. He needs to be able to understand instructions, recognize marks, and even conduct simple communication, as well as the ability to go out and perform tasks.
Therefore, there is this strange classroom in the virtual world of the mind.
Shen Suan decided to start from the most basic literacy and hyphenation, and try to be a qualified enlightenment teacher, injecting a bit of "wisdom" into the guards.
of fire.
Half a month passed by in a hurry.
"Da da"
The sound of horse hooves broke the tranquility of the country road.
Shen Suan took Zhong Yuan and trotted briskly on the dirt road leading to the mass graves of Xishan Mountain.
The summer wind carries the scent of vegetation.
"Master,"
Zhong Yuan followed closely with his horse, with obvious worry on his face. He couldn't help but confirm again, "Are we really... just going for a walk? We will definitely be back before the sun sets? No need to stay overnight?"
Before setting off, Uncle Zhong gave him numerous instructions: If the young master was still stranded near the graveyard at dusk, he must be urged to return, and he could even be forcibly taken away if necessary!
In short, the young master must not be allowed to spend the night in that damn place again!
"Brother Yuan,"
Shen Suan sighed helplessly. This was already the tenth time he had been asked this question on the road.
"Just put your heart back in your stomach!
Young Master, I really have to go do some small errands. I’ll leave as soon as I’m done and I won’t delay!
You will naturally understand it when you get there later. "
His tone was determined.
"Master, don't think your subordinate is too verbose,"
Zhong Yuan scratched his head, his honest face full of worry, "That place is really... too evil!
My subordinate is still scared when I think about the experience of spending the night last time! "
"I know, I know,"
Shen Suan waved his hand, "I'm leaving the good food, drink, peace and comfort in my house to go to that hellish place to seek death? Are you, my master, that stupid?"
"Uh...that's true!"
Zhong Yuan thought for a while and felt that the young master was right, and finally felt a little more at ease.
He suddenly remembered another thing and said hurriedly: "By the way, young master, I almost forgot about the business.
Uncle Zhong said that Baixiu Tower was on the right track and it was time to recruit some workers.
Let Zhong Jin, Zhong Guang and I return to our duties as guards. "
"Hiring a buddy? That's a good thing!"
Shen Suan nodded in agreement, "It's definitely time to take action.
By the way, do you have any idea about the candidate I asked you to secretly identify? "
He is referring to the "dangerous market" for the future
It’s a matter of finding reliable peripheral personnel.
"We have initially shortlisted a few candidates for subordinates,"
Zhong Yuan lowered his voice and said, "They are all smart, tight-spoken, and well-connected guys.
But Uncle Zhong said that the matter was of great importance, and he had to observe and evaluate it again to make sure it was truly reliable and worth using before he could finally make a decision. "
"Well,"
Shen Suan looked serious, "The development of offline development is related to core secrets, so we really need to be cautious.
Take care of yourself, take your time, don't rush.
Just give me a finalized list of candidates before August. "
"Yes!
My subordinates understand! "
